about: Ties (Docs/Design/52-newcomers.md, 4): story starters linking a new wolf to a mentor or a resident. Each has the newcomer's line and the other side's, whether a mentor can take it, what a resident must be to fit it (job categories from scenes::jobCategory, an age range, a need: an apprentice place free), and what it does with a resident (a bond to start from, a small debt the newcomer owes it in pennies, whether the two know each other's names). "fallback" is the one used when no resident fits the chosen starter. The timing: an offer to a mentor stands so many seconds; a tie lapses after so many days or shared scenes; the mentor then rests; the meeting place's marker lasts so long; mentors are looked for so many cells from the arrival.

starters.newcomer: You arrived on the same cart.
starters.other: You came into town on the same cart as a newcomer.

starters.newcomer: They pulled you out of the river on the road here.
starters.other: You pulled a wolf out of the river on the road here; they've just arrived.

starters.newcomer: You carry a letter for them from someone they haven't seen in years.
starters.other: A newcomer carries a letter for you from someone you haven't seen in years.

starters.newcomer: You owe them a small debt.
starters.other: A newcomer owes you a small debt.

starters.newcomer: You're distant cousins; your mothers wrote to each other.
starters.other: A distant cousin has come to town; your mothers wrote to each other.

starters.newcomer: They're looking for an apprentice, and someone told you to ask.
starters.other: You're looking for an apprentice, and someone has told a newcomer to ask you.

starters.newcomer: You both saw something on the road you shouldn't have.
starters.other: You and a newcomer both saw something on the road you shouldn't have.

starters.newcomer: You're new to the town and they've been asked to show you around.
starters.other: You've been asked to show a newcomer around the town.
